newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - May 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - May 27.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on May 27. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The Indonesian Department of Foreign Affairs has said the highly publicised advance voting by Indonesian atheletes in Glasgow, Scotland was invalid because it was not done according to procedure.
Indonesia's police chief said only 123 people have been found dead as a result of a riot and arson in the South Kalimantan capital of Banjarmasin after media reports said at least 142 were killed.
Police in Banjarmasin say they do not yet have any indications of any subversive actions during the rioting in the town on the last day of the election campaign on Friday.

Garuda Indonesia said yesterday it had no problems with its six Airbus A330-300s despite Hong Kong aviation authorities banning the national flag carrier from using the aircraft to fly ot the territory.

Fifty youths who attacked the offices of the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) last July to remove supporters of the ousted PDI leader Megawati Sukarnoputri in an unusual twist are suing the government-approved PDI leader Surjadi for 1.2 billion rupiah which they say he promised them for taking part in the attack.
